stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait, pick your options, then turn the phone to landscape when the game asks you to.
stumbles.why: Locking rotation in portrait seems to conflict with turning the phone to landscape. It never explains how the game shows landscape while rotation is locked, or whether the lock should stay on.

stumbles.quote: The game asks for landscape itself, with a prompt to turn the phone.
stumbles.why: This is the same unexplained tension. If rotation is locked, the screen won't switch to landscape, so it's unclear what turning the phone does.
The three track names aren't explained. Laps and Difficulty list no values at all, so I don't know what the choices are.

stumbles.quote: Top of the phone away from you
stumbles.why: I can't tell which way 'top' points once the phone is in landscape. It's also unclear whether this is tilt relative to the neutral position or an absolute angle.

stumbles.quote: the game records the phone's tilt at that moment as neutral
stumbles.why: The start lights haven't been described, and it's unclear when they appear. If I'm still turning the phone when they go out, neutral would be wrong, and the text doesn't say whether I can recalibrate.

point: Open the page on a motion-sensor phone, lock portrait rotation, choose a track, laps and difficulty, tap Start engine, turn to landscape when prompted, then steer by tilting left or right and accelerate or brake by tilting the top away from or toward you, relative to the neutral tilt captured when the lights go out.
